title: Immunostaining of DDR proteins in senescent cells
protocol: Prepare poly-D-lysinated coverslips at a concentration of 50 μg/ml.
Plate 15-20 x 10^3 cells on coverslips one day before staining.
Wash cells gently twice for 5 minutes each in PBS.
Fix and permeabilize cells with methanol/aceton (1:1) for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Block cells with PBG1x for 30 minutes.
Stain with primary antibodies diluted in PBG1x for 1 hour at room temperature in a humidified chamber.
Wash cells gently three times for 5 minutes each in PBG1x.
Stain with secondary antibodies diluted in PBG1x for 1 hour at room temperature in the dark and humidified chamber.
Wash cells gently twice for 5 minutes each in PBG1x, then twice for 5 minutes each in PBS.
Stain with DAPI for 5 minutes in the dark.
Mount coverslips using 3 μl of Mowiol mounting medium.
Let coverslips dry before microscope analysis.
